name: auto-initial-route
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). Nodes start with no data routes. Once discovery and probing have measured the links, the controller computes A > B > C, installs B and then A, and readings flow. Readings created before that are dropped with reason no_route and counted.
